title: SSC CHSL Tier 1 — 11 August 2023 (Shift 2)
subTitle: Official Memory-Based Previous Year Paper (11:45 AM - 12:45 PM)

questions.questionText:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error.
Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any
error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.
The man / is a / social animal.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that
contains a grammatical error.
Would you / like to / watch an movie / tonight at eight?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given
sentence.
Teja is a successful businessman; he always makes hay when the moon shines.
options: makes hay while the sun sets
makes hay while the sun shines
makes hey while the moon rises
makes hay while the stars twinkle
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Did the company launch a new product last month?
options: Did the new product launch the company last month?
Was the company launched by a new product last month?
Was a new product launched by the company last month?
Did the new product launch by the company last month's?
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the
given sentence.
In according to his advice I took this medicine.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.
Great leaders don’t ignore trivial things.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
Her judicious act made him popular overnight.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:

sentence.

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:

following sentence.
I am trying to study, if it is impossible with all this noise.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.
Suresh stole my book.
options: My book is being stolen by Suresh.
My book got stolen by Suresh.
My book was stolen by Suresh.
My book was being stolen by Suresh.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (C).

questions.questionText:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.
Having a chip on one’s shoulder
options: Having an unnecessary feeling of guilt
Having an irritated and unfriendly attitude
Having a proud and self-centred arrogance
Showing great resistance to any adversities
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:
Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges
the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.
A) he has been
B) everyone he knows
C) so upset about his
D) him so rude to
E) divorce and that made
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (C).

questions.questionText:

She is painfully introverted, but an intelligent girl.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:

given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No correction required’.
Everyone sincerely and positively were ready to find the solution for the serious issue
of sewage system.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

questions.questionText:

order to form a meaningful sentence.
A. what to tell you and how to say it
B. and there is darkness everywhere
C. and I do not quite know
D. the light has gone out of our lives
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (B).

lunacy to his financial advisor.
questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (A).

questions.questionText:

blank.

questions.explanation: The official answer key provided by SSC is Option (D).
